procedural_matters: Lauren Twigg, Jan Kemp and Michal Jodlowski attended the hearing as observers.
Bucky Smith, crew of AUS 21, gave evidence as a witness for NZL 5.
John Croston, crew of AUS 43, gave evidence as a witness for AUS 73.
Kane Sinclair, crew of AUS 73, provided video evidence. 5 David Hudson, jury member, provided video evidence.
Hearing No. 3 was heard together with hearing No. 1 in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since both hearings arose from very closely connected incidents.
The hearing request N°3 did not identify the protestee and so does not comply with RRS 60.3(a). Therefore, the protest is invalid under RRS 60.4(a)(1). The hearing N°3 is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
facts: Wind 12 kts, with a short chop.
AUS 73 entered the Mark 1 zone close-hauled on the starboard tack lay line.
NZL 5 entered the Mark 1 zone close-hauled on port tack 1.5 boat lengths below the port tack lay line.
When NZL 5 was within one boat length in front of AUS 73, she tacked onto starboard.

Before reaching a close-hauled course, when the starboard aft corner of her hull came within 1/2 meter of the port forward quarter of AUS 73, AUS 73 luffed above a close-hauled course and avoided contact.
conclusions: After passing head to wind and before reaching a close-hauled course, NZL 5 failed to keep clear of AUS 73. NZL 5 broke RRS 13.
After NZL 5 passed head to wind from port to starboard tack inside the zone, RRS 18.3 applied between her and AUS 73, who was on starboard and fetching the mark.
NZL 5 caused AUS 73, who was on starboard tack since entering the zone and fetching the mark, to sail above close-hauled to avoid contact. NZL 5 broke RRS 18.3.
